# Clipshaper

> Free, open-source AI clip maker by Hollowbit Studio: turns long videos (podcasts, streams, talks) into short vertical clips with captions for TikTok, Reels and YouTube Shorts. It transcribes with Whisper, picks the best moments with a small local language model (Qwen), follows faces to reframe 16:9 to 9:16, and burns in word-by-word captions. Runs on Mac and Windows, or in the browser at https://hollowbit.dev/clipshaper/try/. Videos are never uploaded; no watermark, no account.

- [Try in the browser](https://hollowbit.dev/clipshaper/try/)
- [Download](https://hollowbit.dev/clipshaper/download.html)
